assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone planet-surface building asset for the space-strategy game Stellar Syndicates. This is 2D raster art rendered to look like a softly realistic 3D building, not a 3D model. A single square 1024 x 1024 PNG cutout with a genuinely transparent background.

STYLE AND FAMILY: matte cream-white steel panels, graphite structural framing, muted amber entrance lighting, very restrained cyan command-console glazing and service lights, a small metallic-gold Terran Charter Authority emblem. Soft semi-realistic rendering, gently weathered material surfaces and seams. Edges defined by light and material, no ink contours, no cel shading, no aggressively glossy edges. Bold readable architecture at a small in-game size; minimal tiny greebles.
CAMERA: elevated three-quarter view from front-left, about 55 degrees above the ground plane, almost orthographic. Doorway faces lower-left; front and right walls visible, with roof surfaces strongly readable.
LIGHT: soft upper-left daylight matching a natural planetary landscape; gentle contrast and a soft attached lower-right cast shadow.
FRAMING: entire building centered on one small compact grey-brown graded foundation apron with a low curb. The pad has only a narrow margin around the structure, feathered irregular outer edge, and subtle contact shadow. Building about 70–75% of canvas width; generous clear margin including antenna and shadow; nothing clipped.
BACKGROUND: actual zero-alpha empty space outside the building/pad/shadow, partially transparent soft shadows. No painted checkerboard, grid, background color, studio backdrop, scene, sky, horizon, vegetation, terrain beyond the tiny pad, roads, vehicles, people, text, labels, numbers, UI or borders. Only the small in-universe Authority emblem is permitted, never a caption or watermark.
This family's later stages must grow upward and add attached architectural sophistication within a compact footprint, not spread into a campus. This is civil administration and communications, not a factory, warehouse, weapons bunker or spaceport.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1: warehouse style reference ONLY. Match its material/color family, ground contact and viewing orientation. Do not copy its curved storage-hall architecture or the checker pattern behind it.
Image 2: Terran Charter Authority emblem reference ONLY: a thin gold ring intersected by three slender unequal vertical spires. Use a small recognizable physical badge above the entrance, not the glowing black background.
Image 3: daylight and gentle rendering reference ONLY. Do not copy any landscape.

SUBJECT: LANDING COMMAND — the first and most modest stage of a colony command-center family.
A small prefabricated landing capsule converted into the settlement's administrative office. One low chamfered rectangular cream-steel command cabin with a shallow faceted roof and dark graphite corner braces; four short visible landing struts are now seated on the compact pad. A narrow horizontal blue-grey command window on the front, one recessed human-scale entrance reached by a very short metal ramp, a small amber doorway lamp, and the modest gold Authority seal directly above the entry. One short fold-out communications mast with a small directional dish mounted to the rear corner, and one neatly attached low utility pod. No wings, engines, thruster effects or flight pose: it has become a permanent ground office. It should look practical, modest and new on the frontier, not a grand headquarters, tall tower or elaborate military base. Give the front cabin a distinctive chamfered outline and a thin amber horizontal accent that can be retained in later upgrades.

Deliver only this one isolated Landing Command building and its tiny foundation/shadow. No comparison sheet or additional buildings.

Preserve its chamfered cream-and-graphite architecture, entrance facing lower-left, thin amber accent band, restrained cyan command glazing, camera orientation and small foundation-pad treatment. Create the requested upgraded building, not a duplicate of this starter. Its background checker pattern is unwanted and MUST NOT be reproduced.
Image 2 supplies only the small metallic-gold Authority seal (ring plus three unequal vertical spires), not its black background or glow.
Image 3 is natural daylight/rendering reference ONLY; do not include its terrain or sky.

SUBJECT: COLONY COMMAND CENTER — stage two, a permanent upgrade from the repurposed landing office.
One compact integrated two-level civic operations building. The original low chamfered entrance cabin remains recognizable at the front, now structurally integrated into permanent graphite footings rather than landing struts. Preserve the thin amber belt, small gold Authority badge above the doorway and short entrance ramp. Add two modest attached administration wings inside the same compact site footprint, with cream armored panels, a few blue-grey/cyan horizontal windows and restrained utility vents. Above the rear-central portion rises one modest raised command room with a wraparound observation window and a tidy communications mast, one small directional dish and short antenna rods. The upper command room is the distinctive new silhouette, only one storey higher than the lower offices, not a skyscraper. Permanent but still frontier-practical, no palace, no military guns, no sprawling campus.

Show obvious progression beyond the simple landing cabin through architecture and vertical height, not excessive scattered modules. Keep the entire structure and pad comfortably within the square with empty transparent margins. Deliver one isolated Colony Command Center, no other stage or comparison sheet. Genuine transparent alpha, never a painted transparency checkerboard.

SUBJECT: SYNDICATE HEADQUARTERS — stage three and the seat of the corporation's capital.
A confident but compact advanced civic headquarters that clearly evolved from the referenced Landing Command. Keep the recognizable chamfered front entrance block, cream steel and graphite ribs, narrow amber horizontal accent, short entrance steps/ramp, and a small physical gold Authority seal above the doorway. Surround the entrance block with two integrated terraced administration wings, not separate buildings. A single distinctive central command tower rises 3–4 storeys from the rear-center of the footprint, with an angular faceted crown, a dark wraparound observation/command window, restrained cyan horizontal lights, cream armored vertical fins, and one elegant compact communications spine. One or two small attached communications dishes are secondary; the tower is the principal readable silhouette. Broad solid low base, progressively narrower upper levels, believable engineering, not precarious. The upgraded corporation identity is expressed by polished civic architecture and a prominent blank dark nameplate area that could later receive the player's name—do not invent a company name or other logo.

This is a small colonial capital landmark, NOT a giant city hall, futuristic megacity, cathedral, castle, weapons factory, hangar, radar farm or spacecraft. Grow upward within approximately the same compact pad envelope as the earlier stages. Leave generous space above the tower; no clipping. Soft material realism and upper-left sun, not cartoon outlines or harsh neon. Deliver one isolated Syndicate Headquarters, no labels and no other stage. Genuine transparent alpha, never a painted transparency checkerboard.
